## Specification

### Component: HoldToConfirm

Press and hold (pointer, or Space / Enter) to confirm a destructive action. A fill sweeps across while you hold, drains back if you release early, and a check pops on completion. A plain click never confirms.

#### Anatomy
```
<Button class="ui-btn ui-btn-outline ui-hold" data-state="idle|holding|done" aria-describedby=desc>
  <span class="ui-hold-layer ui-hold-leaving" aria-hidden>previous label</span>   (mid-morph only)
  <span class="ui-hold-layer" data-enter>icon + label</span>                      destructive text on the surface
  <span class="ui-hold-fill" aria-hidden>                                         destructive fill, clip-path revealed
    <span class="ui-hold-layer">icon + label</span>                               same content, destructive-foreground text
  </span>
</Button>
<span id=desc class="ui-hold-sr">Press and hold for 1.2 seconds to confirm. Release early to cancel.</span>
<span class="ui-hold-sr" role="status" aria-live="polite">doneLabel (when done)</span>
```

#### Props
- `onConfirm: () => void` — called once when the hold completes.
- `duration` — ms to hold, default **1200**.
- `doneLabel` — default "Deleted". `leadingIcon`. `description` — overrides the accessible description (default derives from `duration`).
- `resetAfter` — ms before returning to idle after done, default **1600** (0 keeps it done).
- `onHoldStart`, `onHoldCancel`.
- Everything else is `ButtonProps` (`variant` default `outline`, `size`, `disabled`, ref…) except `loading`, `asChild`, `icon`, `onClick`.

#### Behaviour
- Hold starts on primary-button `pointerdown` (pointer capture on) or on `keydown` Space / Enter (not `repeat`). Releasing (`pointerup`, `pointercancel`, `lostpointercapture`, `keyup`), moving the pointer outside the button's rect, or `blur` cancels.
- Space and Enter default actions are prevented on keydown and keyup so no native click fires; `contextmenu` is prevented (long-press on touch).
- A click with `detail === 0` and no recent key event (assistive-technology activation) starts one full timed hold.
- Completion sets `data-state="done"`, calls `onConfirm`, announces `doneLabel`, then returns to idle after `resetAfter`.
- Colours: idle text `--ui-destructive-text` on the variant surface; fill `--ui-destructive` with `--ui-destructive-foreground` text — each half is a measured ≥ 4.5:1 pair.

#### Motion
- **Press**: `data-state="holding"` scales the button to `.97` on `--ui-spring-snappy` (Button's own `:active` does the same for pointers; this covers keyboard).
- **Fill**: Web Animations API on `.ui-hold-fill`, `clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0)` → `inset(0 0 0 0)`, `duration` ms, `linear`, `fill: forwards`. Clip-path (not scaleX) so the label is never squashed. `finish` = complete.
- **Release early**: current progress `p = currentTime / duration`; animate clip-path from `inset(0 (1-p)*100% 0 0)` back to empty over `160 + 260·p` ms, `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`.
- **Done**: button keyframes `ui-hold-pop` 360ms ease-out (`.97 → 1.035 at 45% → 1`); label morph = width spring `--ui-spring-morph` 550ms + 2px-blur crossfade (220ms in / 160ms out); check draws in 320ms (120ms delay).
- **Reduced motion**: the fill still tracks the hold (it is the state); no press scale, no pop, no drain, no width animation; labels swap with a 1ms fade.

#### Accessibility
- Native `<button>` with `aria-describedby` pointing at the hold instructions (visually hidden).
- Keyboard: Space / Enter (hold). Focus ring: destructive-tinted `0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 35%, transparent)`.
- Completion is announced via a polite live region.

#### Acceptance checks
- A click (down and up within ~100ms) does not call `onConfirm` and leaves the fill empty.
- Holding for `duration` calls `onConfirm` exactly once and shows the done label with a full fill.
- Releasing at ~50% drains the fill back; `onHoldCancel` fires.
- Holding Space for `duration` confirms; keyup earlier cancels; blur cancels.
- The accessible description mentions the duration.

### `ui/components/hold-to-confirm/hold-to-confirm.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../../lib/dom';
import { animateSafe } from '../../lib/spring';
import { CheckGlyph } from '../../lib/glyphs';
import { useCrossfade } from '../../hooks/use-crossfade';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { useMorphWidth } from '../../hooks/use-morph-width';
import { Button, type ButtonProps } from '../button/button';

export type HoldToConfirmState = 'idle' | 'holding' | 'done';

export interface HoldToConfirmProps
  extends Omit<ButtonProps, 'loading' | 'asChild' | 'icon' | 'onClick' | 'onPointerDown'> {
  /** Called once the hold completes. */
  onConfirm: () => void;
  /** Milliseconds the user must hold. Default 1200. */
  duration?: number;
  /** Label after the hold completes. Default "Deleted". */
  doneLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Icon before the label. */
  leadingIcon?: ReactNode;
  /** Text read by assistive tech as the button's description. Defaults to "Press and hold for 1.2 seconds to confirm." */
  description?: string;
  /** Milliseconds before the button returns to idle after completing. Default 1600; 0 keeps it done. */
  resetAfter?: number;
  /** The hold started. */
  onHoldStart?: () => void;
  /** The hold was released early. */
  onHoldCancel?: () => void;
}

const EMPTY = 'inset(0 100% 0 0)';
const FULL = 'inset(0 0 0 0)';
const HOLD_KEYS = new Set([' ', 'Enter']);

function defaultDescription(duration: number) {
  const seconds = Math.round(duration / 100) / 10;
  return `Press and hold for ${seconds} seconds to confirm. Release early to cancel.`;
}

/**
 * HoldToConfirm — press and hold (pointer, or Space / Enter) to confirm a
 * destructive action. A fill sweeps across while you hold, drains back if you
 * let go early, and a check pops when it completes. A plain click never
 * confirms.
 */
export const HoldToConfirm = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, HoldToConfirmProps>(function HoldToConfirm(
  {
    onConfirm,
    duration = 1200,
    doneLabel = 'Deleted',
    leadingIcon,
    description,
    resetAfter = 1600,
    onHoldStart,
    onHoldCancel,
    variant = 'outline',
    disabled,
    className,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<HoldToConfirmState>('idle');
  const innerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const composedRef = useComposedRefs(ref, innerRef);
  const fillRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement | null>(null);
  const animation = useRef<Animation | null>(null);
  const fallbackTimer = useRef(0);
  const resetTimer = useRef(0);
  const holding = useRef(false);
  const stateRef = useRef<HoldToConfirmState>('idle');
  stateRef.current = state;
  const lastKeyAt = useRef(0);
  const callbacks = useRef({ onConfirm, onHoldStart, onHoldCancel });
  callbacks.current = { onConfirm, onHoldStart, onHoldCancel };
  const descId = useId();

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      window.clearTimeout(fallbackTimer.current);
      window.clearTimeout(resetTimer.current);
      animation.current?.cancel();
    },
    [],
  );

  // Once "done" is rendered, the CSS holds the full fill; release the animation
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (state !== 'done') return;
    animation.current?.cancel();
    animation.current = null;
  }, [state]);

  /** Drain the fill from `progress` (0–1) back to empty. */
  const drain = useCallback((progress: number) => {
    const fill = fillRef.current;
    if (!fill || progress <= 0.01 || prefersReducedMotion()) return;
    animateSafe(
      fill,
      [{ clipPath: `inset(0 ${(1 - progress) * 100}% 0 0)` }, { clipPath: EMPTY }],
      { duration: 160 + 260 * progress, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)' },
    );
  }, []);

  const complete = useCallback(() => {
    if (!holding.current) return;
    holding.current = false;
    window.clearTimeout(fallbackTimer.current);
    setState('done');
    callbacks.current.onConfirm();
    if (resetAfter > 0) {
      window.clearTimeout(resetTimer.current);
      resetTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
        drain(1);
        setState('idle');
      }, resetAfter);
    }
  }, [resetAfter, drain]);

  const start = useCallback(() => {
    if (disabled || holding.current || stateRef.current !== 'idle') return;
    const fill = fillRef.current;
    if (!fill) return;
    holding.current = true;
    setState('holding');
    callbacks.current.onHoldStart?.();
    const anim = animateSafe(fill, [{ clipPath: EMPTY }, { clipPath: FULL }], {
      duration,
      easing: 'linear',
      fill: 'forwards',
    });
    if (!anim) {
      fallbackTimer.current = window.setTimeout(complete, duration);
      return;
    }
    animation.current = anim;
    anim.onfinish = () => complete();
  }, [disabled, duration, complete]);

  const release = useCallback(() => {
    if (!holding.current) return;
    holding.current = false;
    window.clearTimeout(fallbackTimer.current);
    const anim = animation.current;
    animation.current = null;
    let progress = 0;
    if (anim) {
      anim.onfinish = null;
      progress = Math.min(1, Number(anim.currentTime ?? 0) / duration);
      anim.cancel();
    }
    setState('idle');
    callbacks.current.onHoldCancel?.();
    drain(progress);
  }, [duration, drain]);

  const handlePointerDown = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (e.pointerType === 'mouse' && e.button !== 0) return;
    start();
    try {
      e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {
      /* capture is best-effort */
    }
  };
  const handlePointerMove = (e: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (!holding.current) return;
    const r = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (e.clientX < r.left || e.clientX > r.right || e.clientY < r.top || e.clientY > r.bottom) release();
  };
  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (!HOLD_KEYS.has(e.key)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    lastKeyAt.current = Date.now();
    if (!e.repeat) start();
  };
  const handleKeyUp = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (!HOLD_KEYS.has(e.key)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    lastKeyAt.current = Date.now();
    release();
  };
  const handleClick = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    // A click with no pointer and no key (screen-reader "activate") counts as a full hold
    if (e.detail === 0 && Date.now() - lastKeyAt.current > 500) start();
  };

  const phase = state === 'done' ? 'done' : 'idle';
  const content: ReactNode =
    phase === 'done' ? (
      <>
        <CheckGlyph />
        {doneLabel}
      </>
    ) : (
      <>
        {leadingIcon}
        {children}
      </>
    );
  const { leaving, animate } = useCrossfade(phase, content);
  useMorphWidth(innerRef, phase);

  const describedBy = [props['aria-describedby'], descId].filter(Boolean).join(' ');

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        {...props}
        ref={composedRef}
        variant={variant}
        disabled={disabled}
        className={cn('ui-hold', className)}
        data-state={state}
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
        onPointerUp={release}
        onPointerCancel={release}
        onLostPointerCapture={release}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onKeyUp={handleKeyUp}
        onBlur={(e) => {
          release();
          props.onBlur?.(e);
        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
        onClick={handleClick}
      >
        {leaving && (
          <span key={`out-${leaving.key}`} className="ui-hold-layer ui-hold-leaving" aria-hidden="true">
            {leaving.node}
          </span>
        )}
        <span key={phase} className="ui-hold-layer" data-enter={animate || undefined}>
          {content}
        </span>
        <span ref={fillRef} className="ui-hold-fill" aria-hidden="true">
          <span key={`fill-${phase}`} className="ui-hold-layer" data-enter={animate || undefined}>
            {content}
          </span>
        </span>
      </Button>
      <span id={descId} className="ui-hold-sr">
        {description ?? defaultDescription(duration)}
      </span>
      <span className="ui-hold-sr" role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
        {state === 'done' ? doneLabel : null}
      </span>
    </>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-crossfade.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

interface Layer<K extends string> {
  key: K;
  node: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Keeps the previous layer alive for `duration` ms after `key` changes so CSS
 * can crossfade it out while the new layer fades in.
 *   const { leaving, animate } = useCrossfade(state, content);
 *   <span key={state} data-enter={animate || undefined}>{content}</span>
 *   {leaving && <span key={`out-${leaving.key}`} aria-hidden>{leaving.node}</span>}
 * `animate` is false until the first change, so nothing animates on mount.
 * Under `prefers-reduced-motion` no outgoing layer is kept.
 */
export function useCrossfade<K extends string>(key: K, node: ReactNode, duration = 160) {
  const [leaving, setLeaving] = useState<Layer<K> | null>(null);
  const last = useRef<Layer<K>>({ key, node });
  const changed = useRef(false);
  const timer = useRef(0);

  if (last.current.key !== key) changed.current = true;

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const prev = last.current;
    last.current = { key, node };
    if (prev.key === key || prefersReducedMotion()) return;
    window.clearTimeout(timer.current);
    setLeaving(prev);
    timer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setLeaving(null), duration + 40);
  });

  useEffect(() => () => window.clearTimeout(timer.current), []);

  return { leaving, animate: changed.current };
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-morph-width.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../lib/dom';
import { animateSafe, readSpring, type SpringName } from '../lib/spring';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * Springs an element's width to its new natural width whenever `key` changes
 * (a label swap, a state change). The element keeps `width: auto`; this
 * measures the old and new widths and animates between them with the Web
 * Animations API, so content never snaps. Interruptible: a change mid-flight
 * starts from the width currently on screen. Skipped for the first render
 * and under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
 *
 * The element should clip its overflow (`overflow: hidden`) so the outgoing
 * content does not spill while the width is still catching up.
 */
export function useMorphWidth(ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, key: unknown, spring: SpringName = 'morph') {
  const previous = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const animation = useRef<Animation | null>(null);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    // Width on screen right now (mid-flight animations included)
    const visual = el.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    const running = animation.current && animation.current.playState === 'running';
    animation.current?.cancel();
    animation.current = null;
    const natural = el.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    const from = running ? visual : previous.current;
    previous.current = natural;
    if (from === null || Math.abs(from - natural) < 1 || prefersReducedMotion()) return;
    const { easing, duration } = readSpring(spring, el);
    const anim = animateSafe(el, [{ width: `${from}px` }, { width: `${natural}px` }], { duration, easing });
    if (!anim) return;
    animation.current = anim;
    anim.onfinish = () => {
      if (animation.current === anim) animation.current = null;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [ref, key, spring]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      animation.current?.cancel();
    },
    [],
  );
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/lib/glyphs.tsx`

```tsx
import type { SVGProps } from 'react';

type GlyphProps = Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'>;

/**
 * Small motion glyphs shared by the morphing buttons. Styles live in
 * styles/components/action-button.css (`ui-glyph-*`).
 */

/** A 14px ring spinner. Inherits currentColor. */
export function SpinnerGlyph({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return <span aria-hidden="true" className={className ? `ui-glyph-spinner ${className}` : 'ui-glyph-spinner'} />;
}

/** A check that draws itself (stroke-dashoffset). */
export function CheckGlyph(props: GlyphProps) {
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={16}
      height={16}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={2.25}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
      focusable="false"
      {...props}
      className={props.className ? `ui-glyph-check ${props.className}` : 'ui-glyph-check'}
    >
      <path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5" pathLength={1} />
    </svg>
  );
}

/** A cross that pops in. */
export function CrossGlyph(props: GlyphProps) {
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={16}
      height={16}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={2.25}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
      focusable="false"
      {...props}
      className={props.className ? `ui-glyph-cross ${props.className}` : 'ui-glyph-cross'}
    >
      <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" />
    </svg>
  );
}
```

### `ui/lib/spring.ts`

```ts
import { prefersReducedMotion } from './dom';

export type SpringName = 'snappy' | 'smooth' | 'morph';

export interface SpringTiming {
  /** A CSS `linear(...)` curve (or a cubic-bezier fallback). */
  easing: string;
  /** Milliseconds. */
  duration: number;
}

const FALLBACK: SpringTiming = { easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)', duration: 420 };

/**
 * Read a spring preset (`--ui-spring-<name>` + `-duration`) from CSS so that
 * Web Animations API animations use exactly the same curve as CSS transitions.
 * WAAPI cannot resolve `var()` in `easing`, hence the computed-style read.
 */
export function readSpring(name: SpringName, el?: Element | null): SpringTiming {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return FALLBACK;
  const style = getComputedStyle(el ?? document.documentElement);
  const easing = style.getPropertyValue(`--ui-spring-${name}`).trim();
  const raw = style.getPropertyValue(`--ui-spring-${name}-duration`).trim();
  let duration = parseFloat(raw);
  if (raw.endsWith('ms')) duration = parseFloat(raw);
  else if (raw.endsWith('s')) duration = parseFloat(raw) * 1000;
  return {
    easing: easing || FALLBACK.easing,
    duration: Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0 ? duration : FALLBACK.duration,
  };
}

/**
 * `el.animate()` that never throws: a browser without `linear()` support
 * rejects the easing, so retry with a plain ease-out. Returns null when
 * the Web Animations API is missing.
 */
export function animateSafe(
  el: Element,
  keyframes: Keyframe[] | PropertyIndexedKeyframes,
  options: KeyframeAnimationOptions,
): Animation | null {
  if (typeof el.animate !== 'function') return null;
  try {
    return el.animate(keyframes, options);
  } catch {
    try {
      return el.animate(keyframes, { ...options, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)' });
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

export { prefersReducedMotion };
```

### `ui/styles/components/hold-to-confirm.css`

```css
/* Hold to confirm -----------------------------------------------------------
   <button class="ui-btn ui-btn-outline ui-hold" data-state="idle|holding|done">
     <span class="ui-hold-layer ui-hold-leaving">…</span>   previous label (fading out)
     <span class="ui-hold-layer">…</span>                   current label, destructive text on the surface
     <span class="ui-hold-fill">                            clipped copy: destructive fill + foreground text
       <span class="ui-hold-layer">…</span>
     </span>
   </button>
   The fill is revealed with clip-path (WAAPI, linear, `duration` ms), so the text
   is never squashed and each half keeps its measured contrast.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-hold.ui-btn {
    --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-destructive-text);
    overflow: hidden;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -webkit-touch-callout: none;
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-hold.ui-btn:hover { --ui-btn-fg: var(--ui-destructive-text); }
  }
  .ui-hold.ui-btn:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 35%, transparent); }

  /* Haptic-style press: the button sinks while it is being held (keyboard too) */
  .ui-hold.ui-btn[data-state="holding"] { transform: scale(0.97); }
  .ui-hold.ui-btn[data-state="done"] {
    border-color: var(--ui-destructive);
    animation: ui-hold-pop 360ms var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }

  .ui-hold-layer {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-hold-layer > svg,
  .ui-hold-layer > .ui-icon { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .ui-hold-layer[data-enter] { animation: ui-action-label-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-hold-leaving {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: ui-action-label-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both;
  }

  /* The sweep */
  .ui-hold-fill {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background-color: var(--ui-destructive);
    color: var(--ui-destructive-foreground);
    clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ui-hold[data-state="done"] .ui-hold-fill { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); }
  .ui-hold[data-state="done"] .ui-hold-fill .ui-glyph-check path { animation-delay: 120ms; }

  /* Screen-reader text (the hold instructions and the result) */
  .ui-hold-sr {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes ui-hold-pop {
  0% { transform: scale(0.97); }
  45% { transform: scale(1.035); }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

/* Reduced motion: the fill still shows progress (it is the state), but nothing pops or lifts */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ui-hold.ui-btn[data-state="holding"] { transform: none; }
  .ui-hold.ui-btn[data-state="done"] { animation: none; }
  .ui-hold-layer[data-enter] { animation: ui-fade-in 1ms both; }
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```


## Usage

**Delete a workspace** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/hold-to-confirm/delete-workspace.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { HoldToConfirm } from '@/ui/components/hold-to-confirm';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

export default function HoldToConfirmDeleteWorkspace() {
  const [deleted, setDeleted] = useState(0);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
      <HoldToConfirm
        leadingIcon={<Icon name="trash" />}
        doneLabel="Workspace deleted"
        onConfirm={() => setDeleted((n) => n + 1)}
      >
        Hold to delete workspace
      </HoldToConfirm>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {deleted ? `“Northwind” was deleted (demo only). Count: ${deleted}.` : 'Hold for 1.2 seconds. Let go early to cancel.'}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
